{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "A slot the description says is not needed is not an item: give it worn false. One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note; then items is empty."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A navy blue silk-blend blouse with a classic pointed collar, tailored to a slightly relaxed fit for easy movement.
Dark indigo straight-leg denim trousers, mid-rise waist, ankle length, and structured cotton twill fabric.
A cropped charcoal wool-blend blazer with notched lapels, single-breasted front, and functional button pockets.
Black leather loafers with a slight heel and almond-shaped toe for comfortable walking through crowds.
Thin gold-plated hoop earrings and a sleek silver watch to complement the classic aesthetic.

This outfit works because it perfectly balances her request for a classic look with the high energy of a rock concert at a club. The dark indigo jeans and navy blouse are staples that define neat formality while allowing for extensive walking without restriction. The wool blazer adds a necessary layer of sophistication against the autumn evening chill inside the venue, adhering to the requirement of an outer layer when the temperature drops below +20 °C. Finally, the subtle metallic accents tie her skin tones together seamlessly, ensuring she fits the context optimally without compromising comfort."}
